name: Raycast landing page by raycast.com
description: A near-black single-column page that opens with a huge centred hero, then alternates short manifesto statements with oversized product screenshots floating on red-orange radial glows. Mid-page the rhythm shifts to dense, colour-coded content: app-branded extension cards (indigo, blue, green), an AI window with chat suggestion chips, avatar-driven testimonials, and a developer bento grid filled with wireframe-blue isometric illustrations, closing on a giant 3D keyboard render and a six-column mega footer. Everything is disciplined single-sans typography on #0b0b0d, with the red gradient reserved for glows, eyebrows and emphasis, so colour is earned, not sprayed.
